accommodation.name: St Christopher's Bruges The Bauhaus
accommodation.notes: Bike rentals available at hostel. Lively hostel bar. Check-in after 14:00 but bag drop available earlier.

arrival.notes: Direct bus from Paris Bercy Seine to Bruges central station

days.title: Bruges in One Day: Medieval Heart, Canals & Beer

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Arrival, bag drop, climb Belfry tower, grab a waffle, and take canal boat tour

activities.name: St Christopher's Hostel The Bauhaus
activities.notes: Drop your bags at the hostel (Langestraat). Walk to Markt square from here (10 mins).

activities.name: Belfry of Bruges (Belfort van Brugge)
activities.notes: Climb the 366 steps for iconic panoramic city views. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

activities.name: Chez Albert
activities.notes: Grab your fresh, authentic Belgian waffle (gaufre). One of the best in Bruges.

activities.name: Canal Boat Tour
activities.notes: Classic 40-minute boat tour of the canals. Multiple departure points around the city. Incredibly photogenic.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Bike trip to Damme: scenic 7km canal-side ride to historic book town

activities.name: Supermarket Stop (near Hostel)
activities.notes: Grab snacks and water supplies for the bike ride.

activities.name: Bike Rental at Hostel & Damme Cycling Route
activities.cost: Bike rental included at hostel or 10-15 EUR elsewhere
activities.notes: Rent your bike directly at the hostel and take the scenic 7 km canal-side path (Damsevaart canal) to the historic book town of Damme and back. Total ~14 km round trip. Flat, easy ride.

secondaryPlaces.name: Damme
secondaryPlaces.notes: Medieval book town with charming squares, cafes, and bookshops. Historic Town Hall and Church of Our Lady.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: De Halve Maan brewery tour with rooftop access

activities.name: De Halve Maan Brewery Tour (Classic 45 mins)
activities.notes: Tour the historic family brewery (since 1856), check out the rooftop terrace with city views, and explore the underground beer pipeline (2 km to bottling plant). Includes one beer.

bookingDetails.instructions: Book online in advance recommended, especially in peak season

timeBlocks.name: night
timeBlocks.description: Unwind at hostel bar and evening stroll through illuminated medieval Bruges

activities.name: St Christopher's Hostel Bar
activities.notes: Unwind and enjoy a drink at the hostel's lively bar. Social atmosphere, Belgian beer selection.

activities.name: Night Walk: Markt Square & Canals
activities.notes: Stroll through the beautifully illuminated medieval squares and empty canals. Markt square, Burg square, and canal bridges are magical at night.

must_try_dishes.description: Authentic Belgian waffles - two types: Brussels waffle (light, rectangular) and Liège waffle (dense, sweet, caramelized). Best fresh from street vendors or specialty shops like Chez Albert.
Classic Belgian dish of steamed mussels (often in white wine, cream, or beer) served with crispy fries. Bruges specialty given coastal proximity.
Slow-cooked beef stew braised in Belgian beer with onions, often served with fries or bread.
World-famous pralines and truffles. Bruges has many artisanal chocolatiers. Try the caramel praliné called 'Brujas' at Galler.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Belgium produces over 1,500 different beers. In Bruges, try Brugse Zot (local blonde or brown ale from De Halve Maan), Trappist beers, or abbey ales. Served in brewery-specific glassware.
Traditional Belgian juniper spirit, predecessor to Dutch gin. Often enjoyed as a digestif.

restaurants.name: Chez Albert
restaurants.notes: Famous for fresh, authentic waffles. Recommended by locals and travel guides.

restaurants.name: De Halve Maan Brewery
restaurants.notes: Historic family brewery since 1856. Rooftop terrace with city views. Underground beer pipeline.

restaurants.name: Bar 2be / The Beer Wall
restaurants.notes: Famous bar with extensive Belgian beer menu. Great location by the canal. Mentioned by Alanxelmundo.

tourist_traps_to_avoid: Overpriced restaurants directly on Markt square - walk one block away for better prices
Pre-packaged 'Belgian' chocolates in tourist shops - seek out artisanal chocolatiers
Waffle stands with excessive toppings marketed to tourists - authentic waffles need minimal toppings

public_transport.overview: Bruges is compact and very walkable. Most attractions are within 15-20 minute walk from center.

ticket_types.name: City bus ticket
ticket_types.notes: Rarely needed for tourists staying in city center

where_to_buy.bus_driver: Cash or card accepted on board

hostel_rental.name: St Christopher's Bruges The Bauhaus
hostel_rental.included: May be included with accommodation - check at reception
hostel_rental.notes: Most convenient option for Damme bike trip

alternative_rentals.name: Bruges Bike Rental
alternative_rentals.notes: Multiple rental shops near train station and city center

bike_rentals.cycling_notes: Bruges is very bike-friendly. Flat terrain. Damme route follows dedicated canal-side bike path.

practical_tips: Bruges is very compact - most attractions are within walking distance
Bike rental highly recommended for Damme trip
Book De Halve Maan brewery tour 1-2 days in advance online
Canal boat tours run March-November, weather permitting
Belfry tower has 366 narrow steps - not suitable for those with mobility issues
October can be rainy - carry umbrella/rain jacket
Many restaurants close between lunch and dinner service (15:00-18:00)
Hostel bag drop available before check-in (14:00)
